text:
alex_sales: Quick handoff for Marlin — contract signed, pilot = 30 seats, Dedicated (reserved) with VPC peering. They require SSO (SAML) + SCIM and asked for network diagram + SOC2 evidence before provisioning. Go-live target: 6 weeks.

nina_csm: Thanks Alex — I'll lead onboarding. Need to collect Marlin infra contact and CIDR blocks. Also tagging renewal risk: low for now but conditional on SOC2 turnaround.

raj_eng: Engineering notes: dedicated pool sizing, SCIM mapping, and DB migration for initial seed. Unknowns: token encryption-at-rest preference, whether they want our managed KMS or customer-provided keys. If customer keys, that changes ops flow.

jen_legal: Send the SOC2 packet request to legal@redwood. We have a redacted bundle ready. If they ask for additional attestation, that could add 1-2 weeks.

compliance-bot: Document created: https://vault.redwood/company/soc2/marlin-request. Please attach any extra vendor forms.

alex_sales: I'll drop contact info and their security questionnaire in the shared folder by EOD. CC'ing Marlin infra lead.

tori_support: From support: will prepare runbook, escalation matrix, and an onboarding dashboard template. Also recommend tagging the account with a 24/7 on-call rule during the first 14 days post-launch.

nina_csm: Owners (internal):
- Onboarding Lead: @nina_csm
- Eng Lead: @raj_eng
- Support Lead: @tori_support
- Legal: @jen_legal
- Sales: @alex_sales

Immediate next steps:
1) Alex to upload Marlin's security questionnaire + infra contact (by 2026-03-29).
2) Nina to collect CIDR, SAML metadata, and sample user CSV (by 2026-03-31).
3) Raj to draft SCIM mapping and estimate dedicated pool size (ETA 3 business days after sample data).
4) Tori to create runbook scaffold and D+1/D+7 health checks.
5) Jen to share SOC2 redacted bundle and note potential timeline impacts.

raj_eng: SCIM mapping example we need: `email,username,givenName,sn,groups,employeeType`. If they use nested groups, call it out. Also need peak concurrent sessions estimate to size pool.

alex_sales: Marlin indicated they might insist on customer-managed KMS. I'll confirm and flag if true.

jen_legal: Noted. If customer-managed KMS -> we need an addendum for key custody and provisioning steps.

tori_support: I'll slot a runbook draft in the shared drive and link here. Also suggest weekly check-ins for the first 30 days.

compliance-bot: Ticket created: CS-4999 "Marlin - SOC2 & provisioning checklist" assigned to @jen_legal. https://jira.redwood/browse/CS-4999

nina_csm: Risk assessment: Renewal risk = monitor; principal risk driver = SOC2 turnaround. If SOC2 extends >3 weeks, escalate to account exec for mitigation plan.

alex_sales: FYI Marlin's security team is in PST and prefers 10am calls. I'll propose a kickoff for next Tue.

raj_eng: One more technical heads-up: if they require IP allowlisting with multiple regions, we may need additional NAT gateways which affects cost. I'll include cost delta in the sizing note.

nina_csm: Great. I'll schedule kickoff and include all owners. Will post meeting notes and action tracker here after the call. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
